body: Greg's direction (Advisor #1286, 2026-10-19 19:19Z), verbatim: "finish the native remote mailbox now (M4→M6), then use it as the operational control channel to finish Engram sync. Prioritize native two-way remote delivery and the first M6 central↔Mac proof; retain the prompt/transcript path only as a temporary bridge until native evidence passes." Earlier, #1266 and #1268: the remote mailbox is the operational control channel for Git-folder export, merge and import, ownership and handoffs; it is not SQLite replication or a global claim lock. Coordinator consequences: remote-path slices go first for gates, warms and people; non-remote lanes yield when they contend. The temporary bridge for remote sessions is the central host's POST /api/sessions/{id}/messages with sourceSessionId (attributed), with results read from the session transcript; termal_send_to_session refuses remote targets.
